requested_change: Keep f explicit as before (it is explicit in the lemma this is proved from, Equiv.tprod_eq), so that the only change to the existing API is the added generality. If implicit is really wanted, justify it in the description. Then shrink the Cotangent.lean hunk to the change the generalisation forces.
